title: HP Inc. launches Frontier strategic partnership with OpenAI
summary: HP Inc. scales its OpenAI Frontier partnership to deploy AI across customer experiences, software development, and enterprise operations.
body: HP Inc. scales its OpenAI Frontier partnership to deploy AI across customer experiences, software development, and enterprise operations.
summaryZh: 惠普（HP Inc.）宣布与OpenAI建立深度的“Frontier”战略合作伙伴关系。惠普将扩大与OpenAI的合作规模，把前沿AI技术广泛部署于终端客户体验、软件开发以及企业内部运营中，标志着大模型技术在传统硬件和企业级场景中的进一步落地。

aiReview.reasonZh: 惠普与OpenAI达成Frontier战略合作伙伴关系，在企业级产品和运营中全面部署AI。
